# Mirai Tech City — Japan's Premier Longevity Biomedical Popup City

> Mirai Tech City is a month-long longevity biomedical popup city and conference series taking place in Kobe, Japan throughout October 2026.

## Overview & Location
- **Location**: Port Island, Kobe Biomedical Innovation Cluster (KBIC), Kobe, Hyogo, Japan.
- **Dates**: October 1–31, 2026 (Residency)
- **Timezone**: Asia/Tokyo (JST)
- **Canonical Website**: https://mirai-tech-city.vercel.app

## Key Events
- **Summit I: Eradicate Disease** (Oct 17–18, 2026): Focused on therapeutics, rejuvenation biotechnology, disease eradication, and gene therapies.
- **Summit II: Extend the Healthspan** (Oct 24–25, 2026): Focused on translational aging science, biomarkers, epigenetic reprogramming, and bridging East & West longevity advances.
- **The Frontier Human Fashion Show & Demo Day** (Oct 26, 2026): A live runway demo day for exoskeletons, neural interfaces, smart prosthetics, haptic suits, biosensors, and AR/VR medical tech.
- **The Residency** (Oct 01–31, 2026): A month-long co-living and building residency for 300 biomedical researchers, engineers, founders, and longevity pioneers.

## Featured Prominent Experts & Speakers
- **Aubrey de Grey, PhD**: Biogerontologist, Founder & President of LEV Foundation (Longevity Escape Velocity).
- **Prof. Brian Kennedy**: Distinguished Professor of Biochemistry & Physiology, Director of Centre for Healthy Longevity at NUS.
- **Prof. Motoshi Hayano**: Associate Professor at Keio University School of Medicine (Epigenetic Reprogramming & Ocular Therapeutics).
- **José Cordeiro**: Transhumanist Scholar, Vice-Chair of Humanity+, Author of *The Death of Death*.
- **Sebastian Brunemeier**: Managing Partner at Healthspan Capital (Longevity Biotech Venture Capital).
- **Irit Rappley, PhD**: Biomedical Scientist and VP of Research.
- **Yuri Deigin**: CEO & Founder of YouthBio Therapeutics (Epigenetic Rejuvenation).
- **Yuki Hanyu**: Founder of Shojinmeat Project & Cellular Agriculture Institute Japan.
- **Prof. Stuart Reid**: Professor of Medical Physics & Bio-Engineering.
- **Prof. Takahiro Yasuda**: Academic & Biomedical Researcher.
